article.title: Non-applicability of the Indian Partnership Act, 1932.
article.content: Save as otherwise provided, the provisions of the Indian Partnership Act, 1932 (9 of 1932) shall not apply to a limited liability partnership.
article.html:
4Non-applicability of the Indian Partnership Act, 1932.

Section 4 · Chapter II · page 7 of the Act

Save as otherwise provided, the provisions of the Indian Partnership Act, 1932 (9 of 1932) shall not apply to a limited liability partnership.
